name: Shadow of the Past
summary: In Stormwind, the trail from a Stockade prisoner leads into the city’s hidden dealings. Baros Alexston sends you to Mathias Shaw after a mysterious visitor spoke with Bazil Thredd.

sections.title: A Lead in the Shadows
sections.body: Baros Alexston cannot identify the visitor who spoke with Bazil Thredd, the Stockade’s chief prisoner. Warden Thelwater’s account has brought investigators to the city architect, but he has no name to offer. Instead, Baros points you toward Master Mathias Shaw, who leads SI:7 and makes it his business to know Stormwind’s secrets.

sections.title: Unmasking the Visitor
sections.body: At SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Mathias Shaw studies the sealed description and sees through the visitor’s alias, Maelik. The marks point to a professional killer, one who casts off names as easily as cloaks. Shaw knows him as an assassin often called Marzon.

sections.title: Treachery in the Nobility
sections.body: Mathias Shaw says Marzon works for Lord Gregor Lescovar, a Stormwind nobleman known for deceit. The connection reaches beyond the Defias Brotherhood’s rebellion in Westfall and into Stormwind’s aristocratic halls.

faq.q: Who sends you to Mathias Shaw?
aliases: quest giver shadow of the past
faq.answer: Baros Alexston, Stormwind’s city architect, sends you to Mathias Shaw because he cannot identify the visitor in the Stockade warden’s notes. Baros says Shaw owes him a personal favor.

faq.q: Where is Master Mathias Shaw located?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw is at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Stormwind. It is the covert intelligence center for the crown’s rogues, scouts, and intelligence officers.

faq.q: Who was the mysterious visitor to the Stockade?
faq.answer: The visitor called himself Maelik. Baros cannot identify him, so he sends the sealed description to Mathias Shaw.

faq.q: Why is Lord Gregor Lescovar involved?
faq.answer: Baros does not mention Lord Gregor Lescovar. Mathias Shaw reveals Lescovar’s part after reading the visitor’s description.
SI:7 means Stormwind Intelligence. It gathers intelligence and carries out covert operations for the Kingdom of Stormwind, at home and abroad.

faq.q: Why does Baros Alexston have pull with SI:7?
faq.answer: Baros says Mathias Shaw owes him a favor, but does not explain what it was for.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see the heights of Alliance tradecraft and political surveillance when you report to Mathias Shaw in Old Town.
As an Alliance member, you see the investigation connect Defias banditry to Stormwind’s nobility.
As a human of Stormwind, you see the kingdom’s ruling class divided during King Varian Wrynn’s absence.
